title: Tamsin and the Autopsy
author: O. M. Sterling
blurb: Ines Thackeray, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
